bridgeHelp: This section connects local developer tools (MCP). The one-time code comes from bridge.cmd; the Bluetooth camera button does not need it. Pair the camera button in your operating system Bluetooth settings, then assign it under Input source.

variantKey: Change the previous character (゛ ゜, small kana)

inputPanel.mouthHelp: Pucker to press the selected key; open your mouth wide to delete.
inputPanel.blinkHelp: Blink to press. Mouth actions are disabled for safety.
inputPanel.externalHelp: Pair a button in the operating system, then bind it here. The camera can still move the selection with your head.
inputPanel.bindingListening: Press the desired key. Escape or Tab cancels.
inputPanel.bindingCanceled: Binding canceled. The previous binding was kept.
inputPanel.bindingTimeout: Binding timed out. The previous binding was kept.
inputPanel.bindingUnsupported: This key cannot be bound. Press another key.
inputPanel.bindingError: Could not save the binding. The previous binding was kept.
inputPanel.bindingOnlyExternal: Binding is available only in external mode.
inputPanel.storageIssue: Storage is unavailable. Settings last until restart.
inputPanel.updateError: Could not apply settings. Current values were kept.

headPanel.doubleStepHelp: Turning your head by the double-step angle set under Sensitivity moves the selection two keys at once in a single motion. It never auto-repeats.

tuning.headHelp: Lower values require less head movement to trigger.
tuning.delayHelp: Pause after a step. Return to a comfortable pose; after the pause, hold it still until navigation unlocks.
tuning.strictHelp: Further right — a fuller eyelid closure is required
tuning.invertHelp: If a left turn selects the right key, toggle this option.
tuning.doubleStepVerticalAngleHelp: Tilting your head up or down by this angle moves the selection two keys at once. It never auto-repeats.
tuning.doubleStepAngleHelp: Independent angle: one head movement moves the selection two keys at once. It never auto-repeats.
tuning.storageWarning: Storage is unavailable. Settings last until restart.
tuning.error: Could not apply settings. Current values are kept.

base: Look at the keyboard comfortably. Keep your head still for a few seconds.
Turn your head right, left, up or down. Blink to press the selected key.
Blink to press the highlighted key once.
Camera or model error. Start again
Use the camera button on this page
tracking.controlError: Key control failed. Recalibrate the neutral head pose.
tracking.eyeUnreliable: Eye signal is unreliable — input paused
tracking.returnCenter: Return closer to your initial comfortable head pose
tracking.turnSignal: eye signal was ambiguous during the turn
tracking.eyeReference: Checking eyes in this pose. Keep them normally open.

mouth.ready: Lips: pucker to press, open your mouth wide to delete.
mouth.acquiring: Keep your face calm and lips relaxed.
mouth.calibrating: Look at the keyboard. Keep your head and face still.

blink.ready: Blink: blink to press the selected key.
blink.calibrating: Look at the keyboard. Keep your head still and eyes normally open.

external.ready: External button: press the assigned key. The camera can still move the selection with your head.
external.acquiring: Press the assigned external button or use your head to select.
external.calibrating: Look at the keyboard. Keep your head still; the external button works separately.

mouthFeedback.release: Relax your lips to finish the gesture.
mouthFeedback.unreliable: Make sure your mouth is visible to the camera.
mouthFeedback.retry: Action not accepted. Repeat the gesture.
